nodes.description: Address of the current contract owner (Owned.owner).
Pending owner address set by transferOwnership and accepted by acceptOwnership.
Public token symbol string of DelightToken.
Public token name string of DelightToken.
Public token decimals value (8).
Cached total supply of the token.
Mapping of holder address to token balance.
Nested mapping of owner to spender to approved allowance.
msg.sender, externally controlled caller address used for authorization and balance lookups.
SafeMath.safeAdd: checked addition of two unsigned integers.
SafeMath.safeSub: checked subtraction of two unsigned integers.
SafeMath.safeMul: checked multiplication of two unsigned integers.
SafeMath.safeDiv: checked division of two unsigned integers.
DelightToken.transfer: moves tokens from msg.sender to a recipient.
DelightToken.approve: sets the allowance msg.sender grants to spender.
DelightToken.transferFrom: moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' consuming msg.sender allowance.
DelightToken.approveAndCall: sets allowance then invokes receiveApproval on the spender contract.
Owner-only rescue function that calls transfer on an arbitrary ERC20 token address.
Payable fallback function of DelightToken that unconditionally reverts.
Owned constructor: initializes owner with msg.sender.
Owner-only function that stages a new owner address in newOwner.
Completes ownership transfer when called by newOwner.
DelightToken constructor: sets metadata, total supply and pre-mines the full balance.
DelightToken.totalSupply: returns _totalSupply minus the balance of address(0).
DelightToken.balanceOf: returns the token balance of tokenOwner.
DelightToken.allowance: returns remaining allowance of spender for tokenOwner.
ERC20Interface.totalSupply declaration.
ERC20Interface.balanceOf declaration.
ERC20Interface.allowance declaration.
ERC20Interface.transfer declaration.
ERC20Interface.approve declaration.
ERC20Interface.transferFrom declaration.
ApproveAndCallFallBack.receiveApproval declaration implemented by the spender contract.
Addition c = a + b inside safeAdd with require(c >= a) guard.
Subtraction c = a - b inside safeSub with require(b <= a) guard.
Multiplication c = a * b inside safeMul with overflow require check.
Division c = a / b inside safeDiv with require(b > 0) guard.
Unchecked raw subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply.
External call to spender.receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) in approveAndCall.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) in transferAnyERC20Token.
Unconditional revert() inside the payable fallback.
Parameter 'to': recipient address of transfer.
Parameter 'tokens': amount moved by transfer.
Parameter 'spender': address granted an allowance.
Parameter 'from': source address of transferFrom.
Parameter 'tokens': amount moved by transferFrom.
Parameter '_newOwner': staged owner address in transferOwnership.
Parameter 'data': arbitrary bytes forwarded to receiveApproval.
Parameter 'tokenAddress': arbitrary ERC20 contract called by transferAnyERC20Token.
Parameter 'tokenOwner': account queried by balanceOf/allowance.
Local return variable c holding a + b in safeAdd.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the debited account inside transfer.
msg.sender is used as the allowance owner inside approve.
msg.sender is used as the spender whose allowance is consumed in transferFrom.
msg.sender is used as the allowance owner and forwarded to receiveApproval in approveAndCall.
Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
TransferOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner, comparing msg.sender with owner.
AcceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner to complete the ownership handover.
transferAnyERC20Token is guarded by onlyOwner via msg.sender comparison.
safeAdd performs the addition a + b represented by the operation node.
safeSub performs the subtraction a - b represented by the operation node.
safeMul performs the multiplication a * b represented by the operation node.
safeDiv performs the division a / b represented by the operation node.
totalSupply evaluates an unchecked subtraction of balances[address(0)].
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom calls safeSub on balances and allowance.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
approveAndCall hands control to an arbitrary spender contract via receiveApproval after updating allowance.
approveAndCall invokes the declared receiveApproval entrypoint on the spender contract.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call into an arbitrary token contract.
The fallback function unconditionally executes revert().
transfer reads the balances mapping.
transfer writes the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
balanceOf reads balances[tokenOwner].
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom updates the balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
The unchecked subtraction uses _totalSupply as minuend.
The unchecked subtraction uses balances[address(0)] as subtrahend.
The constructor initializes _totalSupply.
The constructor pre-mines the entire supply into balances.
The constructor sets the symbol.
The constructor sets the name.
The constructor sets decimals.
transferOwnership writes newOwner under the onlyOwner guard.
acceptOwnership writes owner after validating msg.sender == newOwner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
The Owned constructor writes owner.
The 'to' parameter is the transfer recipient.
The 'tokens' parameter is the transferred amount.
The 'spender' parameter receives the allowance in approve.
The 'spender' parameter receives the allowance and the callback in approveAndCall.
The 'from' parameter is the debited account in transferFrom.
The 'tokens' parameter is the transferred amount in transferFrom.
The '_newOwner' parameter is stored into newOwner under onlyOwner.
The 'data' parameter is forwarded to the spender receiveApproval call.
The 'tokenAddress' parameter determines the external token contract called.
The 'tokenOwner' parameter indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
The 'tokenOwner' parameter indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
safeAdd assigns the addition result to the local return variable c.

normalization_plan.reason: The recipient parameter has no independent security semantics outside transfer.
The amount parameter is only meaningful as the argument of transfer.
The spender parameter only participates in the allowance write of approve.
The source address parameter is only used inside transferFrom.
The amount parameter is only meaningful as the argument of transferFrom.
The staged owner parameter is directly stored by transferOwnership.
The bytes payload is only forwarded by the approveAndCall external call.
The token address parameter selects the external call target in transferAnyERC20Token.
The queried account parameter only indexes balances in balanceOf.
The local return variable c only carries the addition result of safeAdd.
